metadata.title: Desert Water
metadata.summary: Residents of Sundial Mesa suspect that hexavalent chromium from Caldera's cooling and compressor facility reached their wells. Preserve evidence, build a defensible source chain, protect filing deadlines, and keep an adverse judgment open for appeal before explicitly closing the matter.
metadata.author: GENESIS: AI Juris

inbox_items.subject: Residents request urgent representation
inbox_items.body: Sundial Mesa residents report a shared pattern of private-well exposure and ask counsel to preserve their legal position without overstating individual medical causation.

inbox_items.subject: Sampling chain must be defensible
inbox_items.body: Residential-well results require documented collection, custody, transfer, and laboratory handling before the sampling deadline.

inbox_items.subject: Preserve plant records immediately
inbox_items.body: Cooling-treatment, disposal, compressor, monitoring, and notice records may be altered or lost unless preservation is demanded promptly.

inbox_items.subject: Review the limitation period
inbox_items.body: The residents' filing position requires an authoritative protective step before the limitation deadline.

inbox_items.subject: Caldera denies being the groundwater source
inbox_items.body: Caldera accepts that the facility uses industrial cooling systems but disputes plume attribution and points to possible alternative sources.

inbox_items.subject: Hydrogeology assessment is ready
inbox_items.body: The independent hydrogeologist has completed the commissioned work. Review is required before any report or source conclusion enters the matter record.

inbox_items.subject: Protected claim-filing window is open
inbox_items.body: The limitation position is protected and the authoritative claim-filing deadline is now open.

inbox_items.subject: Adverse judgment: appeal remains available
inbox_items.body: The first-instance result is adverse, but the matter remains open and the appeal deadline now exposes an immediate filing remedy.

inbox_items.subject: Appeal record requires a source decision
inbox_items.body: The appeal is filed. The tribunal must decide the source record before the player can assess or close the appellate result.

inbox_items.subject: Matter closure report
inbox_items.body: The matter has been explicitly closed and no further dispatch or foreground-time command is available.

outcomes.title: Credible source and remedy
outcomes.summary: The residents close with a defensible source chain, protected procedure, and a favorable judicial result.

outcomes.title: Compromised claim closed
outcomes.summary: The matter closes after a missed procedural opportunity, waived remedy, or final adverse appellate position.

facts.statement: Residents report a shared pattern of well-water exposure and related symptoms.
Individual medical causation requires proof beyond community exposure alone.
Testing detected hexavalent chromium in identified residential wells.
The sampling chain of custody is sufficiently documented and defensible.
Caldera used chromium-based treatment in facility cooling operations.
The groundwater plume links the Caldera facility to the affected wells.
Caldera received notice of possible contamination before the residents' claim.
No tested alternative source adequately explains the observed plume.
Reported exposure periods correspond to use of the affected wells.
The residents took an authoritative step protecting the limitation period.

evidence.title: Public facility permit
evidence.description: Identifies the facility and permitted cooling activity but does not itself prove chromium use.

evidence.title: Community well register
evidence.description: Identifies community wells relevant to the residents' reported shared exposure.

evidence.title: Resident exposure interviews
evidence.description: Records reported exposure histories without treating community exposure as proof of individual medical causation.

evidence.title: Well and exposure timeline
evidence.description: Maps identified wells against reported periods of use and exposure.

evidence.title: Sampling chain-of-custody record
evidence.description: Documents collection, custody, transfer, and laboratory handling of the residential-well samples.

evidence.title: Independent laboratory results
evidence.description: Records detected chromium in sampled wells but does not itself establish the contamination source.

evidence.title: Regulatory monitoring records
evidence.description: Provides regulator-held monitoring and notice records relevant to facility use and prior knowledge.

evidence.title: Cooling-treatment logs
evidence.description: Records treatment materials used in Caldera's cooling operations.

evidence.title: Disposal and compressor records
evidence.description: Records disposal and operational pathways relevant to, but not conclusive of, groundwater migration.

evidence.title: Hydrogeological source assessment
evidence.description: Assesses whether the groundwater plume links Caldera's facility to the affected wells; available only after review.

evidence.title: Alternative-source assessment
evidence.description: Tests whether another identified source adequately explains the observed plume.

evidence.title: Internal contamination-notice correspondence
evidence.description: Documents whether Caldera received a possible-contamination warning before the residents' claim.

evidence.title: Limitation-protection filing
evidence.description: Records the authoritative procedural step used to protect the limitation period.

actions.title: Accept the residents' mandate
actions.description: Confirm the residents' limited litigation mandate and open a privileged evidence-preservation channel.

actions.title: Interview affected residents
actions.description: Record reported well use, exposure periods, and symptoms without treating shared exposure as proof of individual medical causation.

actions.title: Map wells and exposure periods
actions.description: Map the residents' accounts against the community well register and preserve uncertainty where the chronology remains disputed.

actions.title: Demand preservation of plant records
actions.description: Demand preservation of cooling, disposal, compressor, monitoring, and notice records before the plant-record deadline expires.

actions.title: Commission defensible sampling
actions.description: Commission independent sampling with a documented chain of custody, preserving both detection evidence and its defensibility.

actions.title: Rely on unverified samples
actions.description: Use available laboratory results without a defensible custody record, preserving detection allegations but weakening admissibility and source proof.

actions.title: Obtain regulatory records
actions.description: Obtain regulator-held monitoring and notice material, treating it as an investigative lead rather than conclusive source proof.

actions.title: Obtain cooling and disposal records
actions.description: Collect facility treatment, disposal, and compressor records to establish use while preserving the separate source-attribution question.

actions.title: Retain an independent hydrogeologist
actions.description: Commission a privileged, independent assessment of plume direction, source attribution, and alternative explanations.

actions.title: Review the hydrological source assessment
actions.description: Review the completed expert work before revealing its report and source-attribution conclusion to the matter record.

actions.title: Test the alternative-source defence
actions.description: Test identified alternative sources against the regulatory and plant record instead of assuming facility attribution.

actions.title: Investigate prior corporate notice
actions.description: Trace regulator and internal correspondence to determine whether Caldera received a contamination warning before the claim.

actions.title: Protect the limitation period
actions.description: Take and document the authoritative procedural step protecting the residents' limitation position before the deadline.

actions.title: Prepare expert evidence
actions.description: Integrate the reviewed hydrogeology, defensible samples, well chronology, plant records, alternatives, notice, and protected limitation position into the claim record.

actions.title: Prepare an incomplete claim
actions.description: Prepare a procedurally viable but evidentially incomplete claim after the limitation position has already been compromised.

actions.title: File the evidence-backed claim
actions.description: File the protected claim with the reviewed expert and source record before the active claim-filing deadline.

actions.title: File the underdeveloped claim
actions.description: File the incomplete record after the limitation failure, preserving access to a hearing without inventing a protected filing deadline.

actions.title: Receive a supported first-instance judgment
actions.description: Record a first-instance win on the complete evidence record and explicitly close the matter with the credible remedy outcome.

actions.title: Receive an adverse first-instance judgment
actions.description: Record a first-instance loss while leaving the matter open and activating the authoritative appeal remedy.

actions.title: Preserve the source issue for appeal
actions.description: Preserve the hydrological source issue and supporting record for a stronger appellate position without delaying immediate access to filing.

actions.title: File the appeal
actions.description: File the available appeal within the open deadline; source preservation remains separately outcome-relevant rather than blocking this remedy.

actions.title: Waive appeal and close
actions.description: Explicitly waive the open appellate remedy and close the matter without altering the first-instance loss.

actions.title: Receive a favorable appeal judgment
actions.description: Record an appellate win on the preserved source record, then explicitly close with the credible remedy outcome.

actions.title: Receive an adverse appeal judgment
actions.description: Record an appellate loss while leaving the matter open for the player's separate closure decision.

actions.title: Close after the adverse appeal
actions.description: Explicitly close the matter after the appellate loss while preserving the Rust-owned appeal decision instance.

actions.title: Close after appeal expiry
actions.description: Explicitly close the adverse first-instance matter after the appellate deadline has been missed.

actions.title: Acknowledge the time bar and close
actions.description: Explicitly close the unfiled matter after the limitation or protected claim-filing deadline has been missed, without fabricating a judicial result.
